Sandbox_StoryEngine_Monologue_tooltip: The character mutters short thoughts when feelings change or something happens (first kill, bites, new towns...).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_MonologueAI_tooltip: Write the thoughts with the AI bridge. When off, only built-in lines are used (no API cost).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_MonologueGap_tooltip: Least time between two thoughts of the same character. Bites, low health and first kill ignore this.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_RequireRadio_tooltip: When on, talking to radio contacts, handing over items and paying for trades need a walkie-talkie or ham radio (carried, or placed within 2 tiles).
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ModItemsRatio_toolti: Chance that food, melee weapons and guns in rewards and trades are swapped for similar items from all installed items (including other mods). 0 = vanilla lists only.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Director_tooltip: Twice a day (08:00, 20:00) the AI picks an event: supplies, storms, requests from radio contacts, hordes, helicopters, distress calls.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_NpcRequests_tooltip: Radio contacts ask for items or for help clearing a horde, about once or twice a week.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_DangerEvents_tooltip: Allow the director to send a small horde toward a survivor, or a helicopter over the area.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Journal_tooltip: The AI writes a diary entry every midnight and a memoir when a character dies. Players can read each other's journals.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_ALifeSupport_tooltip: When Project A-Life is running: contacts with trust 50+ can send armed backup on request, and at 70+ they come on their own (once every 3 days) when you are in serious danger or under attack: A-Life raids and robberies, or this mod's chasing hordes and armed gangs. Ignoring a threat brings that group's armed men instead of a horde.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Banter_tooltip: When characters are within 10 tiles of each other, the AI writes a short exchange every 3 in-game hours, and right away when something happens (fighting together, a bite, a horde closing in, quests, radio news, a death). Shown above their heads and kept in the journal. With a companion nearby, this replaces the solo monologue.
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Social: NPC social life (calls, stories, open channel, crises)
Sandbox_StoryEngine_Social_tooltip: Contacts call you 4-6 times a day even without business, each has a personal story that branches on linked quests, they talk among themselves on an open channel, and sometimes several of them ask for help at once so you have to choose.
